name: Ani
source:
Ani is the second youngest sibling from Fawn’s family. 

She hasn’t ever forgiven him for something that happened when they were children.

Though she acts kind, she can also be quite harsh and unkind.

[From [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/10C18D9dLZ_jKI1p7anhfTTnWz5Nkdzt36bNyxHIqcFQ/edit]casting submission form[/url]]
